overloads.semanticRole: Returns the current width (in pixels) of the list box column or column header, and optionally fills minWidth/maxWidth with its resizing limits, addressed as an object-name string (via the leading '*' flag).

discriminatedBy.rule: Chosen when the caller addresses the list box/column via an object-name string (leading '*' passed).

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the current width (in pixels) of the list box column or column header, and optionally fills minWidth/maxWidth with its resizing limits, addressed as a direct Variable reference (no leading '*').

discriminatedBy.rule: Chosen when the caller addresses the list box/column via a direct Variable reference (no leading '*').

constraints: If no minimum and/or maximum resizing limit has been set for the column (via LISTBOX SET COLUMN WIDTH), the corresponding minWidth/maxWidth parameter returns 0.
